response.guide: Alerts are returned grouped by symbol (alphabetically), newest-created first within each symbol. An empty alerts list means the user has no alerts set — a valid result, not an error. Pass alert_id to update_alert or delete_alert; never construct one. Equity alerts carry a bare symbol (AAPL) and crypto alerts the base currency code (BTC, never BTC-USD) — route to get_equity_quotes for equities or get_crypto_quotes for crypto when the user asks how close an alert is to firing, since no live price is included here; get_crypto_quotes takes a pair symbol, so construct it as the symbol + "-USD" for USD-quoted pairs (BTC -> BTC-USD) — append "-USD" only when the symbol has no hyphen already, since it can arrive pre-formed as a pair — or look up a non-USD-quoted pair via get_currency_pairs. Surface enabled=false before telling the user an alert is watching the market.
